answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, under a Semaphore membership tree, evaluate an epoch polynomial whose identity commitments bind each anonymous message to one RLN rate-limit share. The labels pigment, juniper, and zenith are ordinary domain separators, not identities. If an agent sends duplicate messages in one epoch, two signed evaluations provide Shamir shares that reconstruct its private key, enabling instantaneous proof-based collateral slashing
